name: @activepieces/piece-quaderno
description: Quaderno is a tax software that handles sales tax, VAT, and GST for your online business. Automatically calculates tax, sends receipts and invoices, and provides instant multi-channel tax reports for your sales around the world.

account_name.description: Your Quaderno account name https://<your_account_name>.quadernoapp.com/ (the subdomain part of your Quaderno URL) https://<your_account_name>.sandbox-quadernoapp.com/

createContact.name: createContact
createContact.description: Create a new contact in Quaderno (customer or vendor)

firstName.description: The contact's first name (required for person contacts)

language.description: 2-letter ISO language code (e.g., EN, FR, ES)

discount.description: Default discount for this contact (as a percentage)

processorId.description: The ID assigned by an external payment processor (e.g., Stripe customer ID)

processor.description: The external platform where the contact was imported from (e.g., stripe)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact (customer or vendor) in Quaderno via POST, capturing name, address, tax ID/status, and contact details. Use when an agent needs to register a party before billing or recording expenses against them. Requires first name and a 2-letter ISO country code; the Kind prop selects person vs. company. Not idempotent — each call creates another contact even with identical input.

findContact.name: findContact
findContact.description: Search and list contacts from Quaderno

searchQuery.description: Search for contacts by name, email, or tax ID (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100)

aiMetadata.description: Looks up contacts in Quaderno via GET. With a search query it filters contacts by name, email, or tax ID; left empty it lists all contacts (capped by the results limit). Use to resolve a contact before referencing it or to check whether one already exists. Read-only and idempotent.

createExpense.name: createExpense
createExpense.description: Create a new expense in Quaderno

issueDate.description: Date when the expense was issued (YYYY-MM-DD)

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.)

contactLastName.description: The vendor's last name (optional for person contacts)

itemUnitCost.description: Unit cost of the expense item

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code for the expense location

tagList.description: Tags for the expense, separated by commas

aiMetadata.description: Records a new expense in Quaderno via POST, embedding the vendor contact and a single line item (description, quantity, unit cost) along with currency, issue date, and payment method. Use when an agent needs to log a purchase or bill. Requires issue date, currency, vendor first name/country, item details, payment method, and expense country. Not idempotent — each call creates another expense.

createInvoice.name: createInvoice
createInvoice.description: Create a new invoice in Quaderno

issueDate.description: Date when the invoice was issued (YYYY-MM-DD)

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.)

invoiceNumber.description: A unique, sequential code that identifies the invoice

dueDate.description: Date on which payment for this invoice is due (YYYY-MM-DD)

itemDescription.description: Description of the invoice line item

itemUnitCost.description: Unit cost of the invoice item

aiMetadata.description: Issues a new invoice in Quaderno via POST, embedding the customer contact and a single line item (description, quantity, unit cost) with currency and issue date, plus optional invoice number, due date, and tags. Use when an agent needs to bill a customer. Requires issue date, currency, customer first name, and item details. Not idempotent — each call creates another invoice even if the invoice number repeats.
